row.proto: uint64_t Career_MyTeamDriverDetails_SetupSceneDriver(void *self, void *driver, uint64_t opt_stage, const char *str_a, const char *str_b)
row.notes: If the optional stage argument has its present flag (bit 32) set, calls Ui_Play_FacilityStageCutsceneByIndex(self+0x18, stage). Then gets a custom driver slot with Game_FrontendSceneManager_FindOrCreateNewCustomDriver(self+0x08, 0xffff) stored at self+0x28, fills a setup descriptor (vtable 0x145626810) with driver+0x50/+0x54/+0x58 ids, the two strings and fixed flags, and calls Game_FrontendSceneManager_SetupCustomDriver. Spawns the 3D driver model for the driver details and young driver renew screens.
